sequence.cn: 你的老板，最近有没有给你画饼？
sequence.py: Nǐ de lǎobǎn, zuìjìn yǒu méiyǒu gěi nǐ huà bǐng?
sequence.en: Has your boss been "drawing you a cake" lately?

sequence.py: Bié wùhuì, zhège bǐng, bù néng chī.
sequence.en: Don't get me wrong — this cake, you can't eat.

sequence.cn: 画饼，是指用美好的承诺，让你充满希望。
sequence.py: Huà bǐng, shì zhǐ yòng měihǎo de chéngnuò, ràng nǐ chōngmǎn xīwàng.
sequence.en: 画饼 means using beautiful promises to fill you with hope.

sequence.cn: 小李刚进公司时，老板就是个"画饼"大师。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Lǐ gāng jìn gōngsī shí, lǎobǎn jiùshì ge "huà bǐng" dàshī.
sequence.en: When Xiao Li first joined, his boss was already a "cake-drawing" master.

sequence.cn: "好好干，年底升职加薪，明年还带你买房！"
sequence.py: "Hǎohǎo gàn, niándǐ shēngzhí jiāxīn, míngnián hái dài nǐ mǎi fáng!"
sequence.en: "Work hard — year-end promotion and a raise, and next year I'll help you buy a house!"

sequence.cn: 小李听得两眼放光，恨不得天天住在公司。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Lǐ tīng de liǎng yǎn fàngguāng, hènbudé tiāntiān zhù zài gōngsī.
sequence.en: Xiao Li's eyes lit up — he could hardly wait to live at the office every day.

sequence.cn: 他拼命干了一整年，天天加班，终于盼到了年底。
sequence.py: Tā pīnmìng gànle yì zhěng nián, tiāntiān jiābān, zhōngyú pàn dàole niándǐ.
sequence.en: He worked his hardest for a whole year, staying late every day, and finally the year-end he'd longed for arrived.

sequence.cn: 老板拍拍他的肩："今年公司不容易，明年一定给你升！"
sequence.py: Lǎobǎn pāipai tā de jiān: "Jīnnián gōngsī bù róngyì, míngnián yídìng gěi nǐ shēng!"
sequence.en: The boss patted his shoulder: "This year was tough for the company — next year I'll definitely promote you!"

sequence.cn: 小李终于明白：那张"饼"画得再大，也永远吃不到嘴里。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Lǐ zhōngyú míngbái: nà zhāng "bǐng" huà de zài dà, yě yǒngyuǎn chī bu dào zuǐlǐ.
sequence.en: Xiao Li finally understood: no matter how big that "cake" is drawn, you'll never get to eat it.
